title: Complete VC0 shared-stream context service physical calibration
hypothesis: The embodied 112-context admission, descriptor engine, sixteen packet endpoints, and 4x4 VC0 mesh provide a measurable dual-network baseline whose PPA can replace the analytic shared-transport allowance in the Llama7B Phase-2 frontier.

direct_comparison.primary_question: What timing, standard-cell area, and whole-harness power bound are required by the complete canonical VC0 service?
include: producer-supplied source and destination byte addresses
bounded receive windows and completion-owned endpoint release
exclude: source and destination SRAM bitcell capacity
VC1 exact reduction transport, which is measured separately
a zero-cost assumption for future VC0/VC1 mesh sharing

required_evaluations.objective: Measure the complete canonical VC0 shared-SRAM context service on Nangate45.

expected_result.reason: Use the measured complete-service PPA with the separate exact VC1 canary to establish a fully embodied dual-network Phase-2 transport point before evaluating physical mesh sharing.

required_evaluations.acceptance_notes: Require model-to-RTL context equivalence, exact address/payload/write-once checks, 112/7616/60928 manifest quantities, retained service hierarchy, and hierarchical area for each successful physical row. Treat total_power_mw as a whole-harness upper bound. Preserve v1 as an invalid-configuration failure before synthesis, not physical infeasibility.

revision.replacement_contract: SYNTH_HIERARCHICAL retains the elaborated hierarchy without selecting vanished pre-elaboration module names

remaining_abstractions: Source and destination SRAM capacity is accounted by separate macro evidence.
The first embodied point uses separate VC0 and VC1 meshes; a shared-mesh arbitration point remains to be built and compared.
HBM/DRAM service remains external by design.
Whole-harness vectorless power remains an upper bound.
